purpose: Document first-party discovery, local registry context, official map-viewer review, and bounded anonymous parcel geometry access.
assessment: Batna has a locally named Wilaya cadastre directorate, but the bounded review did not verify a public parcel vector endpoint, viewer schema, CRS, safe native parcel identity, or geometry. The official ASGA viewer is general 1:200,000 cartography rather than an evidenced parcel layer.
registryAssessment: Local custodian evidence is the Batna Wilaya cadastre directorate listing. The Algerian cadastre authority domain was identified, while the official national ASGA map viewer provides general cartography. No local Batna parcel API or public cadastral map layer was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: National cadastre authority domain surfaced in the Batna local directorate listing; ordinary HTTPS DNS resolution from the research host failed, so no current JavaScript/configuration or API route could be inspected.

Official ASGA InfoGéolAlgérie viewer identified by search as Cartographie à 1/200 000, with Wilaya and Communes layers. It is general cartography, not a verified cadastral parcel layer; the ordinary request timed out.
Directory listing names the Direction de مسح الأراضي لولاية باتنة, gives a Batna location and phone, and links an-cadastre.dz. Used only as local custodian evidence; no parcel data retained.
